full_name: Ann-Sophie Barwich | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow Indiana University
bio: Ann-Sophie Barwich is a philosopher and cognitive neuroscientist whose work on olfaction investigates how the mind makes sense of scents. At Radcliffe, she will write a book that argues scientific practice is inseparable from philosophical reasoning, rooted not in abstract theory but in the tactile routines of the lab, and that shows through her own cross-disciplinary work how philosophical reasoning can revitalize and disrupt modern science.
